original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Source-bound adaptive sign screening of the frozen PR4470 mixed-target raw moment; compare standalone signs and rejection-only gating, preserving full accepted intervals.
scope_change_reason: The original card asks for an unchanged replay. This opt-in side experiment changes interval widths while preserving certified signs; it does not replace the full registered construction replay.
bottleneck_link: Determine whether a cheap rejection can avoid full moment arithmetic, and explicitly measure the overhead when the candidate must still be fully evaluated.
stop_rule: Stop at seven fixed raw sign cases, source/receipt controls and 21 fresh-process paired measurements; leave production adoption to an actual caller/candidate batch.
author: SHIN09-git
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for SHIN09-git; no subagents, proof assistant or independent human review.

open_questions.question: Does rejection-only screening help one actual candidate batch or sign-only caller?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Accepted candidates can still need the full interval and incur extra work; fixture speedups cannot establish pipeline speedups.
open_questions.first_step: Pin one complete raw-moment caller and its candidate list; retain source bindings and downstream acceptance obligations and compare all accepted, rejected and inconclusive cases.
open_questions.blocked_by: No real candidate batch or complete caller was measured here.
